newsitem.title: EGYPT: CIB plans Egyptian pound bond issue.
newsitem.headline: CIB plans Egyptian pound bond issue.

text.p: Commercial International Bank (CIB) said on Friday it wanted to issue bonds worth about 900 million Egyptian pounds ($260 million), 500 million in Egyptian pounds and the equivalent of 400 million pounds in dollars or other foreign currencies.
Shareholders will meet on January 23 to approve the board's plan, it said.
It gave no further details of the bonds.
The last two Egyptian pound bond issues by Cairo-based banks have been at 0.25 percentage point above the yield on six-month treasury bills, now at 10.06 percent.
